text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all the people cheering for me
had big smiles on their faces—it was so molto buono☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hey, I wanted to ask you too, Trainer... How was my running today?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, seeing you with such a nice smile
makes me so happy, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Seeing your smile, Trainer,
makes me feel kinda—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Now that I'm relieved, I'm getting super hungry~!
choice_data_list: When we get back, we're celebrating with chanko nabe!
When we get back, let's celebrate with chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay~☆
I'm gonna eat a whole bunch and do my best next time too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Does that mean it wasn't satisfying enough?
choice_data_list: You can bring even more smiles!
You can bring out even more smiles!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse!
Trainer, leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'm getting fired up!
I'll turn this whole venue into a chankonabe of smiles!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hishi Akebono looks completely fired up
for the next race!"
